description: Wave 2 — August 2026 supplier intake candidates selected for MKC registration. 40 identities spanning ELITE (10), ROSE (16), and SKYE (14) collections. Sourced from fragrance-list-2026-08-normalized.json. Wave 2 selection authorized by Founder per EP-CAT-P4A (2026-08-18). Dispositions and normalization corrections applied per EP-CAT-P2B and EP-CAT-P3A governance carry-forward. MEN-83 and MEN-87 are legitimate distinct supplier products requiring canonical identity confirmation.

governance.note: supplierName values are exact from normalized source file. Where the raw text is abbreviated, misspelled, or missing brand context, the canonical identity is resolved in the paired research file. Two entries (MEN-83, MEN-87) are confirmed distinct supplier men's products whose canonical commercial identities must be Founder-confirmed before promotion.
